# Yimeng Cao

I am currently pursuing an M.S. in Biostatistics at Columbia University, with a focus on public health data science.

My background includes data science, applied mathematics, and healthcare analytics. I have worked on real-world evidence, predictive modeling, and data-driven decision-making in the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries.

## Research and Professional Interests

- Biostatistics and Epidemiology
- Healthcare Data Science
- Real-World Evidence
- Machine Learning and Predictive Modeling

## About This Website

This website provides an overview of my academic background, professional experience, and interactive data visualization projects.
